title: Which review gates apply per capture mode before publication
question: For each capture mode, which Track3D review steps (point-cloud verification, registration, sign-off) are required before output goes LIVE? Must sign-off publish through the same checked activation as the web app, and who may sign off (can a reviewer approve their own work)?
context: In Antman, non-image runs go through verification, registration (unless automatic) and sign-off, while image runs stop at processing complete (PROC-REQ-014). Sign-off writes the reality status directly, skipping the required-file check and activation updates (PROC-REQ-017). LIVE is DEC-025.
